text:
deploy-bot: Starting rollout v2.14.0 -> 5% canary in us-west1. Preflight checks ON. change window 23:00-02:00 UTC. rollout id=3921

sam: Copy. I'm on dashboards, watching p95 and 5xx.

maria: Noted. I'll keep an eye on error budget burn and traces. Link: https://console.redwood/inference/rollouts/3921

pagerbot: ALERT: embed-service (canary) p95 latency > 300ms in us-west1 — 2m ago. Group: eng-oncall. See: https://alerts.redwood/p/7321

anita: Seeing 5xx spike on canary. Quick log tail: ```
[2026-05-10T23:12:07Z] embed-service canary: upstream timeout 504 user=svc-ingest
[2026-05-10T23:12:09Z] embed-service canary: connection reset by peer
```

kevin: p95 jumped from ~120ms to ~420ms for canary traffic. 5xx rate ~1.8% (target <0.5%). Error budget burn ~6% in last 5m.

maria: Canary is only 5% but the shape looks like a systemic regression (latency + 5xx). Suggest pause and investigate.

sam: Agreed — pausing rollout. `deployctl pause --id 3921`

deploy-bot: Rollout 3921 paused by sam at 2026-05-10T23:14:10Z. Traffic frozen at 5%.

anita: Collecting traces and flamegraphs now. I see a spike in KV cache misses and a backlog on grpc workers. Posting short snippet from observability: `kvcache_miss_rate ↑ 4.2x`

kevin: Two options: pin canary back to previous config (v2-rc9) or rollback to stable (v2-rc8). Which do we prefer for quick mitigation?

maria: For customer-facing stability, prefer rollback to v2-rc8. Pinning may leave degraded behavior.

sam: Onboard with rollback. Runbook step: `deployctl rollback --from 3921 --to v2-rc8 --reason "p95+5xx spike in canary"`

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by sam for rollout 3921 -> target v2-rc8. Notifying infra and LB. ETA ~90s.

pagerbot: INFO: 5xx rate decreasing in us-west1 — current 0.7% (was 1.8%). Continue monitoring.

anita: Logs show connections normalizing, KV cache warm-up in progress. Example: `kvcache: restored warm state after rollback`.

kevin: p95 now ~150ms and trending down. Error budget burn projection back under threshold.

maria: I'll mark the release as rolled back and open follow-up: add stricter canary thresholds (+10% p95 and 0.5% absolute 5xx) and add automated pause on burst.

sam: Filing ticket INF-2145 for post-rollback RCA and release notes update. Will attach traces.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete for rollout 3921 at 2026-05-10T23:16:30Z. Rollout cancelled.

maria: Thanks team. Quick retro: reduce canary step size or add KV warmup in the next candidate.

sam: Agreed. I'll schedule a short sync with runtime and infra tomorrow to discuss kernel selection and cache priming. :thumbsup:

pagerbot: Closing alert group for incident 7321 — status: mitigated.

deploy-bot: Thread summary: rollout 3921 paused -> rollback to v2-rc8 -> rollback complete. Action items: INF-2145 (RCA), update canary thresholds, add cache warmup job.
